shortDescription: Generac NYSE:GNRC skyrocketed to the top of the S&P 500 leaderboard Thursday, rallying as much as 32% before settling with an 18.3% gain after it agreed to supply as much as $8B worth of backup-power generators for Amazon's data centers and issued warrants allowing Amazon to buy Generac shares thro…

children: skyrocketed to the top of the S&P 500 leaderboard Thursday, rallying as much as 32% before settling with an 18.3% gain after it agreed to
as much as $8B worth of backup-power generators for Amazon's data centers and issued warrants allowing Amazon to buy Generac shares through 2033.
The initial $2.4B delivery commitment represents a substantial order for Generac
, and the potential for payments reaching $8B suggests the relationship could extend well beyond the first phase if Amazon continues expanding its data center network.

"This is a massive win for Generac and provides clarity regarding the demand underpinning management's recently announced plan to triple manufacturing capacity for large-format generators by August 2027," William Blair analyst Brian Drab said in a note, adding that the stock could double in price over the next 12-18 months.
The Amazon agreement provides strong visibility for Generac
"at a time when many investors are questioning the durability of capital spending trends in the data center industry," Drab wrote.

"Generac's existing data center backlog already provided strong visibility into 2027, [and] the more important investor question was what would follow as incumbent capacity expanded and lead times normalized. The Amazon delivery schedule provides the first tangible evidence of demand extending into 2028 and is materially larger than the opportunity investors couldpreviously quantify for Hyperscaler 2," according to Cantor Fitzgerald's Manish Somalya.

"Generac's residential rebound could collide with an accelerating data center surge—creating a formidable one-two punch. Watch out," Canaccord Genuity analyst George Gianarikas wrote, reiterating his Buy rating and raising his stock price target to $375 from $275.

title: Generac surges to top of S&P leaderboard as big Amazon deal seals status as data center player
